name: 8VC
identity_check: Confirmed as 8VC (8vc.com), the technology investment firm founded by Joe Lonsdale (Palantir co-founder). The site describes it as a firm that 'builds and invests in' companies, runs the 8VC Build incubation programme (Saronic, Epirus, Resilience), and lists offices at 907 South Congress Avenue, Austin (called the headquarters in the Fund V letter) and Pier 5, San Francisco. The name refers to Fairchild's 'Traitorous Eight' (About page). SEC Form D filings under 8VC Fund II-VII, L.P. carry San Francisco and later Austin addresses. Several partners came from Formation 8, a separate predecessor firm; not to be confused with 8 Roads Ventures or other '8'-named funds. The '8VC Angel' strategy and 8VC Build are parts of the same firm.

thesis_text.value: Invests in and co-founds (through 8VC Build) technology companies that bring software, data and AI to large, legacy-bound industries, extending a 'Smart Enterprise' thesis rooted in Palantir. open_items: No pitch form or application URL: the contact page only says 'Get in touch with our team.' (plus a press email, not recorded). Whether 8VC takes cold inbound is not stated; accepts_cold_inbound left 'unknown'.
No stated check size or typical round size anywhere on 8vc.com, the fund letters or the fund-close coverage.

requires_us_entity left 'unknown': nothing stated, but the portfolio includes UK-based iCOMAT, Nigerian Terra Industries and Saris (San Francisco and Montreal). Nothing found on Indian founders, so that fact is omitted.

portfolio_count_reported not recorded: the Fund V letter says only 'hundreds of portfolio companies'; the homepage says 42 companies founded (Build) since 2016, while the Build page says since 2018. The /companies page lists about 175 company links but is a live list, not a reported count.

Fund sizes for 8VC Fund III (Form D filed 2020-01-30) and Fund IV (Form D filed 2021-06-14) not found; EDGAR full-text search worked with the declared User-Agent but sec.gov/Archives refused it (403), so Form D amounts, first-sale dates and fund-entity details were not read. Fund I close date is only 'roughly two years' before April 2018; the debut fund's legal entity name was not seen in EDGAR results.

Other 8VC vehicles visible in EDGAR results but with no size: 8VC Opportunities Fund II, L.P. (2021), Entrepreneurs Funds I-VII (2016-2026), 8VC AI Fund I-XI, LLC (2024-2026, likely deal SPVs), 8VC Build NRI and Build Saronic SPVs, plus many single-deal SPVs. The 8VC Build programme has no published size or dedicated fund.

Fund VII ($1.5B) comes from Gunderson Dettmer (fund counsel, 2026-07-03) and LP Vintage Investment Partners (July 2026); EDGAR shows a Form D for '8VC Fund VII, L.P.' filed 2026-06-29. 8vc.com has no Fund VII post in its sitemap. Gunderson says Fund VII brings AUM to 'over $6 billion', the same figure 8VC gave after Fund V in 2023; AUM is not recorded.
Founding year not recorded: TechCrunch (2018) says founded in 2015; the Fund VI letter (2025) says 'When we started our firm almost 15 years ago', which probably counts Formation 8 years.

Generalist ~$200M late-stage round led by 8VC (Aug 2026) rests on a Dealroom news page only (it cites a federal filing); no press or company page confirmed it. Generalist's own blog has no post on it.

Fragment: the Series A amount alone is not on fetched pages (company says $56M total). An Axios Pro exclusive (403) reportedly splits it into a General Catalyst/A* co-led seed and 8VC-led Series A; not verified. Fragment HQ and founding year not on fetched pages.

Glimpse later announced a '$35M Series A led by Andreessen Horowitz with continued participation from 8VC and Y Combinator' (tryglimpse.com/post/seriesa), but the page has no date and 8VC had already called its own $10M lead a Series A; not recorded as a separate round.

Not recorded for lack of a dated round page naming 8VC's role: Edra (8VC wrote it led a $6M seed; Series A led by Sequoia, 2026-03-18), Vals (8VC led the seed; a16z-led Series A in Aug 2026), Prime Minute pre-seed (Eclipse lead, 8VC hinted as participant in another repo file, not re-fetched), Sycamore seed (hint only).

Partner focus_sectors come from the bios on 8vc.com: Lonsdale (Build, Palantir/Anduril/Saronic/Epirus; Cambium and Overland quotes), Medwell (logistics and transportation; co-founded Terminal Logistics, Baton, Gallatin), Moore (runs Defense, boards of Saronic, Epirus, iCOMAT, Terra), White (defense strategy), Zehfuss (defense, manufacturing, supply chain), McLane (AI apps and robotics; Fragment and Generalist posts), Rose (aerospace, semiconductors, energy). The team page does not give formal partner titles for most investment-team members.
